title: Orange moved by psychokinesis in a vivid dream

tellings.quote: suddenly bam, the orange um starts it moves like 8 10 in just like as if something had pushed it.

plain: A researcher named Deep Prasad says that when he was about 12, in a vivid dream set in his family's drawing room, he moved an orange with his mind, a power called psychokinesis. He says it suddenly slid eight or ten inches "as if something had pushed it", and he mentions a person called Miss Kaur in the story, which he tells on Jesse Michels's podcast as an early hint of unusual abilities.
